name: global-lithological-map-glim-v1
title: Global Lithological Map Database (GLiM) v1.0, 0.5-degree grid
description: Hartmann and Moosdorf's original global lithology grid and class-code table, extracted without modification from hartmann-moosdorf_2012.zip. The 360 by 720 ASCII grid contains 16 lithological classes at 0.5-degree resolution. Thermal conductivity is derived downstream using separate assumptions.

sources.title: Hartmann and Moosdorf (2012), GLiM v1.0, gridded to 0.5 degrees
Hartmann and Moosdorf (2012), The new global lithological map database GLiM
Use in Franzmann et al. (2025), section 2.3, equation (1)

ethos:attribution: Hartmann, Jens; Moosdorf, Nils (2012): Global Lithological Map Database v1.0 (gridded to 0.5-degree spatial resolution). PANGAEA. https://doi.org/10.1594/PANGAEA.788537. CC BY 3.0.
ethos:provenance: Original files recovered from Franzmann's dissertation archive and preserved on 2026-09-09. The ASCII grid matches the archived distribution ZIP member byte for byte. Neither conductivity mapping nor resampling is applied here.
